# Vendored map libraries

- Leaflet 1.9.4: https://leafletjs.com/ — BSD 2-Clause; see `LEAFLET-LICENSE`.
- Leaflet.markercluster 1.5.3: https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet.markercluster — MIT; see `MARKERCLUSTER-LICENSE`.

These files come from the published npm packages via unpkg. Their CSS and JavaScript are embedded in the generated pages. The app uses its own marker icons; Leaflet's image assets are not needed.
